text: Seven chapters ago, Jaffle Shop's leadership named five real gaps in their ad hoc SQL. This capstone closed every one of them, end to end.

Snowflake roles and schema separation closed the access gap. A tested, documented dbt model layer with a snapshot and shared macros closed the safety-net gap. A scheduled Python script and a CI pipeline, proven against a real incident, closed the rest.

This platform now has two warehouses, two roles, a RAW DEV PROD split, a governed dbt project, a logged and scheduled ingestion script, a required CI check, and a Power BI layer that only ever sees verified data.
This Advanced tier assumed the Beginner and Intermediate tiers' staging models and early marts already existed, spending its time on the governance layer most introductory material skips entirely.

A real team takes this further: more custom tests, a deploy job that builds prod automatically on merge, more sources through the same ingestion pattern, and eventually a real orchestrator. This capstone, and the full Analytics Engineer path, is complete.
